domain-information: A scout travels on a scouting trip to find new players for the club.
A scout records observations in a performance report of a player after a match.
A scout submits scouting reports of players containing performance reports to the scouting coordinator for review.
A scouting coordinator of the club reviews scouting reports from multiple scouts to identify promising players.
A scouting coordinator organizes a scouting trip for the club’s scouts.
A scouting coordinator updates the club’s watchlist with newly evaluated scouting reports.
A sports director of the club reviews the watchlist to decide on which players to approach.
A sports director discusses a contract proposal containing a contract with the player’s agent.
A sports director approves player contracts with the players once terms are finalized.
A player agent works for a player.
A player agent reviews the contract proposal.

domain objects.name: Scout
domain objects.description: An individual employed by the club to identify and evaluate potential players.

domain objects.name: Scouting Trip
domain objects.description: A trip organized for scouts to observe players during matches or training sessions.

domain objects.name: Player
domain objects.description: An athlete who may be evaluated, recruited, or contracted by the club.

domain objects.name: Performance Report
domain objects.description: A detailed record of a player's performance in a match or event, created by a scout.

domain objects.name: Scouting Report
domain objects.description: A compiled document summarizing scouting findings, including performance reports and evaluations.

domain objects.name: Scouting Coordinator
domain objects.description: A club staff member who manages scouting operations and reviews scouting reports.

domain objects.name: Club
domain objects.description: The organization employing scouts, coordinators, and directors to manage recruitment and player relations.

domain objects.name: Sports Director
domain objects.description: A senior official responsible for player recruitment decisions and contract negotiations.

domain objects.name: Watchlist
domain objects.description: An internal list of priority players being monitored by the club.

domain objects.name: Player Agent
domain objects.description: A representative who manages a player's career, including contracts and negotiations.

domain objects.name: Contract Proposal
domain objects.description: A preliminary document outlining proposed terms of a player contract.

associations.description: A scout travels on a scouting trip to observe players.
A scout writes a performance report for a player after a match.
A scout compiles performance reports into a scouting report for review.
A scouting coordinator organizes scouting trips for scouts.
A scouting coordinator reviews scouting reports submitted by scouts.
A scouting coordinator updates the watchlist with scouting reports of priority players.
A sports director reviews the watchlist to select players for potential recruitment.
A sports director creates a contract proposal for a player’s agent to review.
A player agent reviews the contract proposal received from the sports director.
A sports director approves the final player contract once terms are agreed.
A player signs the finalized contract with the club.
A player agent represents and advises the player in negotiations.
